# Illucrum

> Illucrum sells fixed-price SEO audits to small and medium-sized businesses, covering Google rankings and AI answers. There are six audits: four built for one kind of website, each with an AI search section, plus a Technical audit and a GEO audit that each cover one layer in depth. Every audit ends in a written report in which every point is scored from 1 to 10 and every fix is put in order of priority.

Key facts:

- Six audits: SaaS, E-commerce, Local business, Website (service firms, agencies, B2B), Technical, and GEO (AI search visibility).
- Prices are published at https://illucrum.com/pricing/ and are the same for every client. At the time of writing: USD 2,000 for the SaaS, E-commerce, Local business, Website and GEO audits, and USD 1,000 for the Technical audit. The price does not depend on the size of the site.
- Delivery: 5 to 8 days for the SaaS, E-commerce, Local business, Website and GEO audits; 3 to 5 days for the Technical audit.
- Process: the client gets in touch and picks an audit, receives the invoice, the audit is carried out, and the report is sent as soon as the invoice is paid.
- Included: every point checked and scored with a status (good, needs attention or critical), a prioritized fix list, and findings tied to the client's real pages and figures, each dated. The report is a PDF.
- Not included: implementing the fixes, ongoing monitoring or reporting, traffic or revenue forecasts, and ranking guarantees. There are no retainers, subscriptions or add-ons, and nothing is sold after the report.
- Access needed: read-only access to Google Search Console and Google Analytics 4. Nothing on the client's site or accounts is changed.
- One audit covers one website.
- Operated by Illucrum LLC (Texas, United States). Contact: szymon.kokot@illucrum.com

## Audits

- [SaaS SEO audit](https://illucrum.com/audits/saas-seo-audit/): 54 points in 10 sections for software sold through a trial, demo or freemium plan. Funnel keywords, pricing and feature pages, JavaScript rendering, review platforms and AI answers.
- [E-commerce SEO audit](https://illucrum.com/audits/ecommerce-seo-audit/): 54 points in 8 sections for online stores on any platform. Platform duplicates, filter pages, product data, shopping results and AI answers.
- [Local business SEO audit](https://illucrum.com/audits/local-seo-audit/): 54 points in 9 sections for businesses that serve a local area. Google Business Profile, reviews, listings, local pages and map rankings.
- [Website SEO audit](https://illucrum.com/audits/seo-audit/): 54 points in 9 sections for service firms, consultancies, agencies and B2B companies (51 points if the business has no office or service area).
- [Technical SEO audit](https://illucrum.com/audits/technical-seo-audit/): 36 points in 9 sections for any site. Crawling, indexing, rendering, speed, mobile, security and AI crawler access, without keyword or content work.
- [GEO audit](https://illucrum.com/audits/geo-audit/): 51 points in 7 sections on visibility in ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude, Copilot and Google's AI answers.
- [All audits compared](https://illucrum.com/audits/): which audit fits which kind of site.

## Free tool

A free bulk SEO checker. It fetches up to 25 URLs per run through a relay that stores nothing, reads the HTML each server returns (it does not run JavaScript) and builds the results in the browser, with CSV export. No account needed.

- [Bulk SEO checker](https://illucrum.com/tools/bulk-checker/)
- [Meta title and description check](https://illucrum.com/tools/bulk-checker/meta-tag-check/)
- [Heading check (H1 to H6)](https://illucrum.com/tools/bulk-checker/heading-check/)
- [Image alt text check](https://illucrum.com/tools/bulk-checker/alt-text-check/)
- [Word count check](https://illucrum.com/tools/bulk-checker/word-count-check/)
- [Canonical tag check](https://illucrum.com/tools/bulk-checker/canonical-check/)
- [Open Graph and Twitter Card check](https://illucrum.com/tools/bulk-checker/open-graph-check/)
- [Schema markup check](https://illucrum.com/tools/bulk-checker/schema-check/)
